Requiring G to lie on BC gives s = -4/3 s + 8, hence (7/3)s = 8 and s = 24/7. This s is less than 6 and 8, so E and F lie on AB and AC within their segments. The area of the square is s^2 = (24/7)^2 = 576/49. The data are consistent with the coordinates given and with the description that the opposite vertex of the square lies on BC.
